Criteria:
- P1: Dependencies: does every step come after the steps whose results it needs? If a requirement of step B uses something that a requirement of step A creates (a name, a command, a connection, data, a schema, a part that is reused), B needs A. Name each missing dependency as 'A -> B' (A must finish before B) and say what B needs from A.
- P2: Coverage: is each requirement's work done by build and test steps that really do it?
- P3: Acceptance criteria: are they concrete and checkable?
- P4: Granularity: no duplicated steps and no step split into trivial pieces?

The research, verify, design and review steps and the order research -> design -> build -> test -> documents -> review come from a template and are correct. Steps listed as 'after: X' already depend on X (directly); a dependency through other steps also counts.

Material:
Requirements:
R1 [must] Draw an ER diagram for the hostel booking system.
R2 [must] The schema must be in third normal form.
R3 [must] Implement endpoints to create, list and cancel bookings.
R4 [must] Every endpoint must return JSON and proper HTTP status codes.
R5 [must] Protect the endpoints with token authentication.
R6 [must] Use the schema from Part A.
R7 [must] Write integration tests for every endpoint of Part B.
R8 [should] Tests should run in the CI pipeline.

Plan steps:
research [research] Research the approach (requirements: -; after: -) criteria: every research question has an answer with sources; the answers name the options considered
verify [research] Check the research findings (requirements: -; after: research) criteria: every claim the design uses is supported by a source; unsupported claims are marked
design [design] Design the solution (requirements: -; after: verify) criteria: each part has a module and an interface; the skeleton runs; the design follows the constraints
T1 [implement] Part A: Implement: Draw an ER diagram for the hostel booking system (requirements: R1; after: design) criteria: R1: Draw an ER diagram for the hostel booking system.
T4 [implement] Part B: Implement booking endpoints (requirements: R3, R6; after: T1) criteria: Create endpoint returns 201 and booking data in JSON; List endpoint returns 200 and an array of bookings in JSON; Cancel endpoint returns 204 on successful deletion
T2 [test] Part A: Check: Draw an ER diagram for the hostel booking system (requirements: R1; after: T1) criteria: R1 works as stated
T3 [test] Check quality of Part A (requirements: R2; after: T1) criteria: R2: The schema must be in third normal form.
T5 [implement] Part B: Add token authentication (requirements: R5; after: T4) criteria: Endpoints reject requests without a valid token with 401; Endpoints accept requests with a valid token; Invalid token returns 401
T6 [implement] Part B: Ensure JSON responses and status codes (requirements: R4; after: T5) criteria: All responses have Content‑Type: application/json; Create returns 201, List returns 200, Cancel returns 204; Error cases return appropriate 4xx codes with JSON error body
T8 [test] Part B: Test authentication enforcement (requirements: R5; after: T5) criteria: Requests without token receive 401; Requests with valid token succeed; Requests with invalid token receive 401
T10 [test] Part C: Write integration tests for all endpoints (requirements: R7; after: T6) criteria: R7: Write integration tests for every endpoint of Part B.
T7 [test] Part B: Test booking endpoint functionality (requirements: R3; after: T6) criteria: Create test passes when a booking is stored and 201 returned; List test returns previously created bookings with 200; Cancel test removes a booking and returns 204
T9 [test] Part B: Test JSON format and status codes (requirements: R4; after: T6) criteria: All successful responses have JSON bodies; Status codes match the specification for each endpoint; Error responses include JSON error details
T11 [test] Part C: Configure CI pipeline to run tests (requirements: R8; after: T10) criteria: R8: Tests should run in the CI pipeline.
T12 [document] Prepare diagram (requirements: -; after: T2, T3, T7, T8, T9, T11) criteria: D1 exists: diagram as PDF; it matches the finished, tested work
T13 [document] Prepare test report (requirements: -; after: T2, T3, T7, T8, T9, T11) criteria: D2 exists: test report as PDF; it matches the finished, tested work
review [review] Final review (requirements: -; after: T12, T13) criteria: every must requirement is met; every deliverable is present; D1 handed in: diagram (PDF); D2 handed in: test report (PDF)
